title: Wall Mount Retractable Hooks And Garment Rod 2-1/2-Inch Hanging Space Solid Brass | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom storage with a wall mount retractable hooks and garment rod that extends to give you 2-1/2 inches of hanging space, then retracts to stay out of the way.

  • Retractable function: pulls out for 2-1/2" of hanging space and pushes back in when not needed
  • Solid brass construction: built for everyday use
  • 15 lb capacity: supports coats, robes, and towels
  • Customizable tip: remove the included knob tip and replace it with a cabinet knob of your choice
  • Wall mount design: helps keep floor space clear for a modern, crisp bathroom look

Specs & installation

  • Mounting type: Wall mount (fits standard interior walls)
  • Included hardware: 6/32 toggles; all mounting hardware included
  • Drilling required: 3/4" diameter hole through drywall and three small holes around
  • Overall dimensions: 3.75" W x 2" H x 2" L
  • Projection: 1"
  • Weight capacity: 15 lb
  • Product weight: 1 lb
  • Finish options: multiple designer finish options available, including statement colors

_previous.title: Modern Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
